notes.title: Update Notes for Sep 22
notes.content:
Updates:
[list]
[*]We have added an option in Settings > Game > Unlocked Cursor to have your cursor unlocked and visible at all times.
[*]We have reduced the number of enemies appearing in the later zones.
[/list]

notes.title: Q&A with the devs! ⛵ - Steam Next Fest Livestream #2
notes.content:
This is Captains of the Wacky Waters, a singleplayer fast-paced boat roguelike where krakens wear moustaches!

We're excited to participate in the Steam Next Fest! We will be broadcasting a gameplay of our latest demo while answering any questions in the chat.

If you like what you see, you can check out our [url=https://twitter.com/WackyWatersGame]Twitter[/url] and maybe find out some secret in the demo...

Play the Demo now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1571130/Captains_of_the_Wacky_Wate
